{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Final verification of premises
premise_1 = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum() == 6
premise_2 = df['revenue'].dtype == 'object'  # string
premise_3 = set(df['status'].unique()) == {'completed', 'refunded'}

# Check for commas in revenue
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# Only for non-test rows
non_test_rows = df['revenue'] != '999999.99'
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & non_test_rows]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()

print(f"Premise 1 (6 test orders): {premise_1}")
print(f"Premise 2 (revenue is string): {premise_2}")
print(f"Premise 3 (status has only two values): {premise_3}")
print(f"Revenue contains commas: {has_commas}")
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders: {total_revenue}")

# Return value
print(total_revenue)"}
